title: fastapi: Bug report from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is fastapi (an open-source Python library). Bug report from a user of this library:

> With an older Sentry SDK, which wraps the endpoint each time FastAPI builds a route's request handler, our app eventually crashes with `RecursionError`. For routes added with `include_router()`, FastAPI seems to build a new request handler on every request, so the wrappers pile up: the Nth request runs the endpoint through N wrappers. A route's request handler (from `get_route_handler()`) should be built once and reused across requests, also for routes in included routers, separately for each place a router is included (different prefixes or `default_response_class`). Dependency overrides and routes added to a router later must still take effect.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
